lines.1: 「I use my legs against men too.」
lines.6: 「Hey, didn't you just injure him? Isn't that against the rules?」
lines.7: 「He may have a bruise on his stomach.」
lines.9: 「Heh... heh... I gave it everything I had, so introduce me to your friend... Preferably one with a bust over ninety...」
lines.10: 「Huh? Are you stupid? Kiss the floor.」
lines.12: 「Tch. One hit, seriously...? You useless piece of garbage! You hear me?!」
lines.14: 「He is already unconscious... More importantly, is he not your ally?」
lines.15: 「Don't call me 'you'! I've got a slightly awkward but perfectly good surname: Kanisawa!」
lines.16: 「Well, this just means you're an opponent worth getting serious about. How about we shake hands and promise each other a fair fight?」
lines.17: 「Oh, and of course I haven't hidden any thumbtacks in my hand.」
lines.18: 「Ordinarily, we would bow. But if you want a handshake, I will oblige.」
lines.19: 「(What an idiot. She doesn't know I've been practicing joint locks on Leo and Fukahire.)」
lines.20: 「(Martial-arts master or not, once I lock her joint, I win. The instant she accepts the handshake is my chance.)」
lines.22: 「Now! Grab the right hand and wrench it up!」
lines.24: 「Hahaha! There, I've got you! Oh no, what will you do?! You were so confident, and now I've locked your joint!」
lines.25: 「I let you continue in silence, only for a joint lock. Well, I suppose that is the extent of it.」
lines.26: 「...Huh? I've got it locked perfectly. Doesn't it hurt?」
lines.27: 「Joint locks have little effect on me. Like so.」
lines.28: 「Th-this feeling... Don't tell me you dislocated your own joint?!」
lines.29: 「Correct. I can dislocate most of my joints at will and put them straight back. Escape complete.」
lines.30: 「N-no way... This move has finished off almost everyone else.」
lines.31: 「Heh. I told you I was an athlete.」
lines.33: 「Now it is my turn. Brace yourself. You cannot escape my technique.」
lines.36: 「Hey, look. Someone else is still getting punished by Tecchan.」
lines.37: 「That is a second-year, no doubt. How foolish, to know nothing of the Iron Disciplinarian's terror.」
lines.40: 「Ghh... Uhhh... Hah, what a boring attack. It made me yawn so hard... I started crying... sniff.」
lines.41: 「That is the spirit. Come again, Kanisawa.」
lines.42: 「Oh, and tell Leo Tsushima to come see me later.」
lines.43: 「Ghh... I really... will... come back! I'll... be back!」
lines.44: 「Good grief. At least she has spirit.」
lines.45: 「She certainly is more than a junior can handle.」
lines.46: 「As her senior, I will have to begin by properly correcting the way she speaks.」
